ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) base surface with a high frequency of small, discrete high-intensity (white) pixel clusters. Estimated ratio of 85% low-intensity to 15% high-intensity pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive distribution of high-contrast white circular and ring-shaped blobs across both lobes. Concentrated high-intensity mass visible at the distal tips (lobes' outer edges) where solid white barnacle colonies are present.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated sharp V-shaped depression with an approximate 50-degree interior angle at the central axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular sawtooth pattern with pixel-amplitude variations of 5-10 pixels along the entire continuous linear boundary from the median notch to the tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate concave curvature fitted to the trailing edge of both lobes, transitioning to sharp upward points at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely populated spatial clusters of ring-like white pixel formations (rosettes) distributed across approximately 70% of the visible fluke surface, indicative of historic barnacle attachment points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint horizontal linear pixel disruptions visible on the inner-middle region of the right lobe and diagonal linear scratches on the lower section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, three-dimensional white calcified clusters (barnacle colonies) attached to the distal tips and trailing edges, causing localized geometric distortion of the fluke silhouette.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-contrast 'ring' patterns where the center of the scar maintains low-intensity (black) pixels while the perimeter is high-intensity (white).
